purpose: Teach: ヨット/カビ/就寝/ポッドキャスト/セルフ/時差/三位一体/皇太子

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがヨットの修理を手伝われた
lines.en: When you were young, your father used to help with yacht repairs.
lines.style: Soft, distant memory. Voice settles on the opening word. Slow, searching pace—reaching back to retrieve something half-forgotten. Slight lift at the end, offering rather than telling.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お風呂のカビ取りをまめにされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and your grandfather was so careful about cleaning the mold in the bathroom, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, gently teasing. Light rhythm, almost playful. The affection of a long marriage—noticing and calling out his small habits. Soft landing on the endearment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは就寝時刻が早かった
lines.en: When you were young, your father always went to bed early.
lines.style: Quieter now, eyes a little distant. Even pace, almost conversational, but with the quality of someone talking to themselves as much as to her. Trailing off slightly—wondering at the memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ラジオを毎晩聴かれてポッドキャストの先駆けだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your grandfather listened to the radio every night—he was ahead of his time with that, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Bright recognition. She's listening but also reclaiming the narrative, gently steering back to what she remembers. Warm, conspiratorial tone. The slight smile in her voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは食事をセルフで召し上がられた
lines.en: When you were young, your father ate his meals by himself.
lines.style: Voice flattens slightly, more uncertain. The phrasing is oddly formal—as if he's searching for the right word, or speaking something he's half-learned. Quiet, tentative. A pause before the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、海外出張時の時差にも強かったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather was always so good with jet lag on his business trips overseas, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle redirection, almost patient. She's not correcting him, but offering what she knows instead. Warm, steady tone. The rhythm of someone who's learned to listen and then to gently suggest.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが三位一体の教義を学ばれた
lines.en: When you were young, your father studied the doctrine of the Trinity.
lines.style: Very quiet now. Almost reverent, as if the words are fragile. Slow, careful enunciation. Each word placed deliberately. The voice of someone naming something sacred, or something they don't quite understand.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、皇太子殿下のニュースを楽しみにされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather always looked forward to the news about the Crown Prince, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warmth and acceptance. The tone of someone gently closing a door—not unkindly, but with certainty. A soft exhale at the end, like letting something go with love.
